snippet.title: Beavageddon - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Beavageddon on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3631070/Beavageddon/

Fire up your bulldozer and set out for vengeance in Beavageddon! Reduce cities to rubble while fighting off hordes of enemies trying to stop your rampage. Upgrade your bulldozer, enhance your arsenal, and unlock new animal pilots with unique skillsets in this roguelike auto-shooter.

#indiegame #steam #nextfest #roguelike #roguelite #beavers #dozer #satisfying
